title: Shiitake and Crunch German Strudel
description: A German-inspired dessert featuring shiitake and crunch, wrapped in a sweet pastry.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sugar, free, and shiitake. Mix well.
Add crunch and mix until well combined.
Roll out a sheet of puff pastry to a large rectangle.
Spread the shiitake mixture onto the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border.
Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with a little water and cut a few slits in the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
